author: jaelee1111
quote: GTA used to be about escapism. GTA 6 isn't even GTA anymore. You pay for a franchise you know and get blindsided with something totally different. If you sell a cockroach and call it a lobster, you're scamming people.  Tell them it's a cockroach before they buy it! Betrayed and robbed. This time, the devs literally GTA'd their own fans and buyers.
